trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No multiplayer, no DLC and no second playthrough are needed. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum at about 200 hours and difficulty 4/10.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 1; it pops when you start the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2; it pops when Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the final mission. Free-roam stays open afterwards, so nothing is locked away by finishing the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The bar is lenient — closer to 60% of true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going after this pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see what you have done. Most of them happen on their own while you work on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx publishes a guide to every range and gold medal; the medals are not hard, and they also raise your Focus level for Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total). PowerPyx has a guide to every location; you only need one win per location, not every race.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations in the game, so pick the ones you are fastest at and do not repeat a location — only new wins count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home (from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once; the extra challenges are not required.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. In Chapter 3 Andy calls you and texts her address in Belville, which marks the questline. Finish all 5 of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams; he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. Dive for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — he marks purple chest icons on the map and you dig them up with the metal detector, then bring them back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a while in Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish all 5 of his jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain stranger strands count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed. The big optional questlines do NOT count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are not strangers for this trophy. Finish 8 counting strands; every stranger is still around in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — check Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list, then drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering a car in good condition pays more. Doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditate as both Jason and Lucia at each spot — that counts double. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE (possibly): one meditation only happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she will meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. It is still unclear whether that one is required for the trophy, so do it while you can. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts you and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker), then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. There are 15 Target Decks in total and all of them are needed for the 100% checklist. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. PowerPyx publishes a guide to every set's locations; you only need 3 sets, so pick the ones closest together and leave the rest.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots by holding Up then R1 while looking at them. There are far more than 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Just scan whatever you pass and it adds up.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies — leave this for near the end, then pick the easiest ones you have left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone (not just the flashing search area). Easiest route: ride a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 bank vault missions, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, with your partner beside you. Rob 3 shops in a row while keeping the flashing red/blue wanted level — never let it drop to the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a few items in each, break the safe in the back room, and if it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the last shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 of the game's 557 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The 100% checklist needs 200, so this pops on the way. Check Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles for your totals.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch it out. Line up 5 enemies (gang operations work well), wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. It does not count on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels and grows by doing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be connected to a boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. You must fly 1 km away from the airport before it pops, and the pop is a little delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot some enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it (kicking trips the alarm). Inside, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which teaches bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard opens the vault, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip (once you have done his Payday Loans quests) to mark more security vans. There are 8 large bank jobs in total — 5 for this trophy, all 8 for the 100% checklist. Every vault robbery gives an instant 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to break the trail. Up to $205,000 per bank.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, it only pops once you escape the red heat radius, or use a Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx has a guide to the best plane and route for unfogging quickly.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations. Rob just one operation per gang for this trophy — all 39 are needed for the 100% checklist, so it pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track them under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After you get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City, then drive it straight through the showroom window. Only that exact car counts — it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed until you are further down the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically in Chapter 2 by the optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs, bought at Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns and you can come back for the rest, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between them. Buy a gym membership and always train together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle — because while one character works out, the other finishes their training automatically. Filter gyms on the map under Activities. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on the notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) — a little demon face appears on screen whenever an action counts. Profiles run from Professional (stealthy robberies, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going that far. It happens passively while you chase the other trophies; if you are still short at the end, running over civilians and cops in a car farms it fast.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has cracked this one yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue in Little Cuba, Vice City, possibly robbing it again in a specific way. Do not trust any walkthrough that claims a method without a source; check the PowerPyx guide for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Walk up to it and it drops the woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded, like Vice City or Ocean Beach, so you do not run out of targets.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not all at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally while you do the vaults for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos at the 11 tattoo studios. Clothes, shoes and haircuts count too, but they add up slowly.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app was installed on your phone, and you buy through that app. The 4 story garages do not count. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to raise the money.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). Registering vehicles needs garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each one adds parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
